trajectory.development: Book 24: a generation that came of age after Book 20 has never seen the labour, and the Brightwater inheritance splits into counted and uncounted practice within one generation.
trajectory.becomes_available: Earlier condition: from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right (E1, recorded), so the generation after has not seen the labour (E6, derived). Inferred from those items; the split in E4 has unknown legacy and is cited, not treated as recorded.
trajectory.changes: Shared return labour is no longer one practice: counted and uncounted return differ within one generation, so each later stage must say which practice it addresses.
trajectory.quote: A generation that came of age after Book 20 has never seen the labour, because lineage crews perform it under the Right.

trajectory.development: Book 24: the labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule, and the Special Draw Right's review point falls in the same Book as an agent-proposed placement.
trajectory.becomes_available: Inferred, not recorded: it follows from the agent-proposed Working Book entries E5 and E7, with the generation of s1 asked to give back the water before it is owed (E5). No source text in the cited items states the Book 24 placement.
trajectory.changes: Return labour is first given by people, so the Right's training condition (s3) can be read against real repair. What the source's reversal for the review point does is not stated in the cited items.
trajectory.quote: Book 24 is where the Long Return's labour gap is first met by people rather than by a schedule.

trajectory.development: Outside apprentices are trained under the Special Draw Right and their repair is demonstrated, so the condition the Right carries is tested.
trajectory.becomes_available: Available once training starts: the Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage (E7), and the maintenance lineages need the condition demonstrated (E3, an agent inference).
trajectory.changes: The Right stops being carried unseen by lineage crews and becomes a demonstrated condition; E3 says that without the demonstration the Right is exposed.
trajectory.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.

trajectory.development: If the public capability record that Book 24 exports is used, repair can be seen per person and not only counted.
trajectory.becomes_available: Book 24 exports a new kind of record that says who can repair, separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance (E5, agent-proposed; excerpt truncated). Its use is not stated in the cited items.
trajectory.changes: Repair can then be read per person alongside the counted and uncounted practice of s1; whether the record changes any standing is not stated in the cited items.
trajectory.quote: exports one new kind of record: a public capability record

trajectory.development: The cohort practising both counted and uncounted return may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work, though Book 24 names no body to grant that standing.
trajectory.becomes_available: Conditional on s1: E8 describes the cohort as 'now practising both counted and uncounted return' and says it 'may claim standing' (hypothetical). E8 says Book 24 names no body that would grant that standing and creates none.
trajectory.changes: Coordination of channel work would then include uncounted practice. Whether Book 25 names a granting body is not stated in the cited items; E14 shows only that its excerpts repeat Book 24's text.
trajectory.quote: may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work

relations.reason: s1 supplies the uncounted generation that E5 asks to give back water in s2. The split (E4) has unknown legacy and E5 is agent-proposed, so the link helps the review but is not shown to be necessary.
relations.quote: A generation that refuses to be counted is asked to give back the water before it is owed.

relations.reason: Replaces the earlier prerequisite on the review point. E7 makes the Right conditional on training, but the cited items do not say the review must precede training; the review is where the condition could be tested.
relations.quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.

relations.reason: Both sit in Book 24's element set (E5, agent-proposed): the labour is met by people and the public record is exported. Whether the record is used to show shared repair is not stated; the link is thematic only.
relations.quote: exports one new kind of record: a public capability record

relations.reason: Withdraws the earlier enables link: E8 never mentions a record and relates standing to a granting body, which Book 24 does not name. No cited premise links the record to standing.
relations.quote: Book 24 names no body that would grant that standing and creates none.

relations.reason: E8 ties the standing claim to the cohort's practice of counted and uncounted return, but the claim is hypothetical and the split is not shown to be necessary for it.
relations.quote: The cohort, now practising both counted and uncounted return, may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work.

alternative_paths.ordering: Demonstrate training (s3) before the review point (s2), so the review tests a condition already shown rather than one only promised.
alternative_paths.effect: The review would test demonstrated repair by outside apprentices, and the maintenance lineages' stated need for demonstration is met first. The reordering changes the review's condition, not its content. Nothing in the cited items bars it.
alternative_paths.quote: they need the condition demonstrated or the Right is exposed

alternative_paths.ordering: Keep the labour gap in Book 24 but move the review point out of Book 24, so the Right's condition is tested later.
alternative_paths.effect: Book 24 keeps the labour gap but loses the review placement it carries as an agent-proposed entry. Whether the source's reversal bears on the move is not stated in the cited items.
alternative_paths.quote: Its review point falls in Book 24 (agent-proposed as P1; the source gives a reversal for it).

alternative_paths.ordering: Raise the standing question (s5) in Book 25 rather than Book 24, leaving Book 24's own absence in place.
alternative_paths.effect: Book 24 stays as E8 states it, naming no granting body. Book 25's excerpts repeat Book 24's text (E14), so whether Book 25 is a distinct placement for the question is unresolved.
alternative_paths.quote: Book 24 names no body that would grant that standing and creates none.

opportunities.text: If the public capability record (s4) is read against demonstrated training (s3), repair can be seen per person in a way that neither the counted tally nor the training shows alone.
opportunities.quote: a public capability record, separate from debt, tally and aggregate balance, that says who can repair

opportunities.text: If the cohort makes the claim, counted and uncounted return together (s1) would be its basis; neither the split nor a bare claim makes coordination possible on its own.
opportunities.quote: may claim standing in how the valley coordinates its channel work

reader_experience: Advisory. A reader meets the unseen labour through a generation that has never seen it (s1), then meets the labour first met by people in Book 24 (s2). Later stages stay conditional, so Book 24 reads on its own: it still shows the split, the unseen labour and the absence of any granting body, with no later stage needed.
open_decisions: Whether Book 25's five repeated elements are intended repetition or duplicates, since their text matches Book 24 (E14).
Whether the Special Draw Right's review point stays in Book 24, given it is an agent-proposed placement and the source's reversal is not described.
Whether the public capability record is used to show repair per person, and whether it bears on the cohort's standing.
Whether any body should grant the cohort's standing, since Book 24 names none and creates none (E8).
uncertainty: E5 is an excerpt that stops at 'rather than who'; the rest of the record is not shown, so its full definition is not stated.
E7 says 'the source gives a reversal for it' but the cited items do not say what the reversal is.
E4 and E10 are unknown_legacy, so the origin of the counted and uncounted split is not stated.
Books 9-11 (E1) and Book 20 (E6) are cited, but only Books 24 and 25 were read, so no stage is placed in those earlier Books.

criticism_assessments.reason: The stage on the labour gap and review point was labelled recorded, but its Book 24 content rests on E5 and E7, both agent-proposed, and E7 calls the review point agent-proposed. It is now inferred (s2), and the basis is traced to those entries.

E8 is hypothetical ('may claim standing') and its absence statement covers Book 24 only. E14 records excerpt coverage and repeated text, not an absence in Books 24 or 25. The standing stage (s5) stays conditional and the Book 25 point is marked not stated in the cited items.
E8 never mentions a record, so the enables link from the capability record to standing has no cited premise. The link is withdrawn and the pair is marked independent.

E7 makes the Right conditional on training, not the review point necessary for training, so the prerequisite claimed more than the cited necessity. It is now preparation (thematic); no relation here is recorded as necessary.

changes_from_prior: Still stands: that from Book 20 lineage crews carry channel repair under the Special Draw Right is recorded, and the Book 24 split and unseen labour read from it stand, now as inferred.
Changed: the labour-gap and review-point stage is inferred rather than recorded, and the standing stage is conditional, with the absence limited to Book 24.

Changed: the prerequisite on the review point is now preparation (thematic), and the record-to-standing enables link is withdrawn as independent, because the cited items give conditions and no premise for it.
Stage ids are array positions: s1 is the first trajectory item. The unseen-labour stage is now s1 and the labour-gap stage is now s2.
